The '''Nargons''' were a [[biot]]ically created species of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with prehensile tails and lizard-like features. They fought for the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]], who had created them. They aided the brothers in taking over the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] and were placed under the command of [[Mirta Gev]]'s [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces. A large number of them were killed in missions for the Columi, with the majority wiped out during the [[Assault on Base Prime]].
